text:
anjali: quick question — we need a canonical policy for zone preference + failover ordering. two parts: header override precedence (X-Redwood-Region / X-Redwood-Zone / geo-ip), and sticky affinity behavior. also want what telemetry to surface in console. thoughts?

mike: +1. my vote: explicit Zone header wins, then Region header, then geo-ip. header should be opt-in per-route.

kevin: agree on header precedence. add: allow admin-only override for SLA customers (force-region). also we need clear fallback ordering when target zone is down — zone -> region siblings -> cross-region fallback.

sam: sticky affinity: keep it simple — 5m by default, configurable per-route. use cookie + header fallback. cookie name rwd_affinity, signed. if route has high qps, allow short TTL (30s) to rebalance.

ops: telemetry we should emit: route_level.failover.count, route_level.failover.last_target, route_level.latency.p95, route_level.affinity.active_sessions, route_level.header_overrides.count. expose these in console and alerting.

anjali: regarding latency-based failover: do we want p95 > threshold over 30s window to trigger failover? Concern about flapping.

mike: require 3 consecutive windows (30s each) + cool-down 60s before re-evaluating. fallback should be sticky for that client until cooldown ends unless header forces otherwise.

kevin: edge case: what if zone is degraded but region sibling has higher cost (eg different instance type)? We should allow a cost-sensitivity flag: prefer lower-latency even if higher cost OR prefer cheaper capacity. policy = {latency_priority: true/false}.

sam: +1. also need a way to opt a route into model-variant fallback vs region fallback. e.g., fallback_to_variant: true falls back to quantized model in same zone before crossing region.

anjali: rough config example that I think captures precedence and options:

```
route: /v1/generate
match:
  host: api.redwood.ai
  path_prefix: /v1/generate
routing:
  header_precedence: ["X-Redwood-Zone", "X-Redwood-Region", "Geo-IP"]
  affinity:
    method: cookie
    cookie_name: rwd_affinity
    default_ttl_seconds: 300
    adjustable_per_route: true
  failover:
    windows: 3
    window_seconds: 30
    cool_down_seconds: 60
    order: ["zone_peers", "region_peers", "cross_region"]
  costs_sensitive: false
  fallback_to_variant: true
```

ops: that config looks good. console UX notes: show the effective routing chain for a route (visual), allow devs to simulate headers ("simulate: X-Redwood-Zone=us-west-2a"), show recent failover events and active affinity buckets.

kevin: implementation note: header precedence should be evaluated after ACL/auth checks but before quota enforcement so quota attribution remains consistent. also store last_fallback_region in the request.trace for debugging.

sam: for telemetry, also emit samples of RTT per-hop and a small hit-sample of request headers (sanitized) to understand misconfigurations.

anjali: agree. I'll draft RFC with config + console mocks and metrics list. plan: canary on staging next Tue, roll to prod by end of week if no issues.

infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled rollout to staging route /v1/generate at 2026-03-25T03:00Z.

mike: sounds good. I'll add e2e test that asserts header override wins and that failover cooldown prevents flapping.

anjali: thanks — will ping when RFC is up :thumbsup:
